name: WdgM
description: Configuration of the WdgM (Watchdog Manager) module.

children.name: WdgMConfigSet
children.description: This container describes one of multiple configuration sets of WdgM.

children.name: WdgMInitialMode
children.description: The mode that the Watchdog Manager is in after it has been initialized.

children.name: WdgMDemEventParameterRefs
children.description: Container for the references to DemEventParameter elements which shall be invoked using the API Dem_ReportErrorStatus API in case the corresponding error occurs. The EventId is taken from the referenced DemEventParameter's DemEventId value. The standardized errors are provided in the container and can be extended by vendor specific error references.

children.name: WDGM_E_IMPROPER_CALLER
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the defensive behavior checks have detected an improper caller. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete, atp.StatusComment=This reference is set to obsolete and will be removed in R 4.3, atp.StatusRevisionBegin=4.2.2

children.name: WDGM_E_MONITORING
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "Monitoring has failed (Global Supervision Status has reached WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_STOPPED) and a watchdog reset will occur" has occurred. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete, atp.StatusComment=use WDGM_E_SUPERVISION instead, atp.StatusRevisionBegin=4.2.2

children.name: WDGM_E_SET_MODE
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "Watchdog drivers' mode switch has failed" has occurred.

children.name: WDGM_E_SUPERVISION
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "Supervision has failed (Global Supervision Status has reached WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_STOPPED) and a watchdog reset will occur" has occurred.

children.name: WdgMMode
children.description: The container describes one of several modes of the Watchdog Manager.

children.name: WdgMExpiredSupervisionCycleTol
children.description: This parameter shall be used to define a value that fixes the amount of expired supervision cycles for how long the blocking of watchdog triggering shall be postponed, AFTER THE GLOBAL SUPERVISION STATUS HAS REACHED THE STATE EXPIRED.

children.name: WdgMModeId
children.description: This parameter fixes the identifier for the mode. This identifier is for instance passed as a parameter to the WdgM_SetMode service.

children.name: WdgMSupervisionCycle
children.description: This parameter defines the schedule period of the main function WdgM_MainFunction.

children.name: WdgMAliveSupervision
children.description: This container collects all configuration parameters of Alive-Supervision of one Checkpoint. Note that each Checkpoint may have different parameters. For example, it may have different min and max margin.

children.name: WdgMExpectedAliveIndications
children.description: This parameter contains the amount of expected alive indications of the Checkpoint within the referenced amount of defined supervision cycles according to corresponding SE.

children.name: WdgMMaxMargin
children.description: This parameter contains the amount of alive indications of the Checkpoint that are acceptable to be additional to the expected alive indications within the corresponding supervision reference cycle.

children.name: WdgMMinMargin
children.description: This parameter contains the amount of alive indications of the Checkpoint that are acceptable to be missed from the expected alive indications within the corresponding supervision reference cycle.

children.name: WdgMSupervisionReferenceCycle
children.description: This parameter shall contain the amount of supervision cycles to be used as reference by the alive-supervision mechanism to perform the checkup with counted alive indications according to corresponding SE.

children.name: WdgMAliveSupervisionCheckpointRef
children.description: Reference to Checkpoint within a Supervised Entity that shall be supervised.

children.name: WdgMDeadlineSupervision
children.description: This container collects all configuration parameters for Deadline Supervision for a Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMDeadlineMax
children.description: This parameter contains the longest time span after which the deadline is considered to be met.

children.name: WdgMDeadlineMin
children.description: This parameter contains the shortest time span after which the deadline is considered to be met.

children.name: WdgMDeadlineStartRef
children.description: This is the reference to the start Checkpoint for Deadline Supervision.

children.name: WdgMDeadlineStopRef
children.description: This is the reference to the stop Checkpoint for Deadline Supervision.

children.name: WdgMExternalLogicalSupervision
children.description: This container collects all configuration parameters for Logical Supervision for one external graph.

children.name: WdgMExternalCheckpointFinalRef
children.description: This is the reference to the final Checkpoint(s) for this External Graph.

children.name: WdgMExternalCheckpointInitialRef
children.description: This is the reference to the initial Checkpoint(s) for this External Graph.

children.name: WdgMExternalTransition
children.description: This container collects the Checkpoints for an External Transition across Supervised Entities.

children.name: WdgMExternalTransitionDestRef
children.description: This is the reference to the destination Checkpoint of an External Transition.

children.name: WdgMExternalTransitionSourceRef
children.description: This is the reference to the source Checkpoint of an External Transition.

children.name: WdgMLocalStatusParams
children.description: This container collects all configuration parameters for the Local Status of a Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMFailedAliveSupervisionRefCycleTol
children.description: This parameter shall contain the acceptable amount of reference cycles with incorrect/failed alive supervisions for this Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMLocalStatusSupervisedEntityRef
children.description: This is the reference to the Supervised Entity for which the Local Status parameters are specified.

children.name: WdgMTrigger
children.description: This container collects all configuration parameters for the triggering of hardware watchdogs.

children.name: WdgMTriggerConditionValue
children.description: This parameter shall contain the value that is passed to WdgIf_SetTriggerCondition for this watchdog.

children.name: WdgMWatchdogMode
children.description: This parameter contains the watchdog mode that shall be used for the referenced watchdog in this Watchdog Manager mode.

metadata.LITERALS: WDGIF_FAST_MODE AUTOSAR_ECUC WDGIF_OFF_MODE AUTOSAR_ECUC WDGIF_SLOW_MODE AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: WdgMTriggerWatchdogRef
children.description: This parameter is a reference to the configured watchdog.

children.name: WdgMGeneral
children.description: Container defines all general configuration parameters of the Watchdog Manager.

children.name: WdgMDefensiveBehavior
children.description: Preprocessor switch to enable/disable the defensive behavior of the Watchdog Manager module. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete, atp.StatusComment=This parameter is set to obsolete and will be removed in R 4.3, atp.StatusRevisionBegin=4.2.2

children.name: WdgMDemStoppedSupervisionReport
children.description: Parameter to enable/disable the error reporting to DEM.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: A notification to DEM is sent if the Watchdog Manager reaches the state WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_STOPPED. false: The notification is disabled.

children.name: WdgMDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

children.name: WdgMImmediateReset
children.description: This parameter enables/disablse the immediate reset feature in case of alive-supervision failure.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Immediate reset is enabled false: Immediate reset is disabled

children.name: WdgMOffModeEnabled
children.description: This parameter enables/disables the selection of the "OffMode" of the watchdog driver.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: "OffMode" selection is allowed false: "OffMode" selection is disallowed

children.name: WdgMVersionInfoApi
children.description: Preprocessor switch to enable/disable the existence of the API WdgM_GetVersionInfo. Shall be used to remove unneeded code segments.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: API is enabled false: API is disabled

children.name: WdgMCallerIds
children.description: Contains the definition of valid CallerIds for the callers who have permission to call the function WdgM_SetMode. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete, atp.StatusComment=This container is set to obsolete and will be removed in R4.3, atp.StatusRevisionBegin=4.2.2

children.name: WdgMCallerId
children.description: This parameter defines one valid CallerId for the callers who have permission to call the function WdgM_SetMode. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete, atp.StatusComment=This parameter is set to obsolete and will be removed in R4.3, atp.StatusRevisionBegin=4.2.2

children.name: WdgMSupervisedEntity
children.description: This container collects all common (mode-independent) parameters of a Supervised Entity to be supervised by the Watchdog Manager.

children.name: WdgMSupervisedEntityId
children.description: This parameter shall contain the unique identifier of the supervised entity.

children.name: WdgMEcucPartitionRef
children.description: Denotes in which "EcucPartition" the supervised entity is executed. When the partition is stopped, the supervised entity shall be de-activated in the WdgM to avoid an ECU reset.

children.name: WdgMOSCounter
children.description: OS counter used by Watchdog Manager to perform the deadline supervision of the Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMOsApplicationRef
children.description: Optional reference to an OS Application. Beware, the Watchdog Manager module will trigger a partition restart of this OS Application when the corresponding Supervised Entity reaches WDGM_LOCAL_STATUS_FAILED.

children.name: WdgMInternalCheckpointInitialRef
children.description: This is the reference to the initial Checkpoint for this Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMInternallCheckpointFinalRef
children.description: This is the reference to the final Checkpoint(s) for this Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMCheckpoint
children.description: This container collects all Checkpoints of this Supervised Entity. Each Supervised Entity has at least one Checkpoint.

children.name: WdgMCheckpointId
children.description: This parameter shall contain the unique identifier of Checkpoint.

children.name: WdgMInternalTransition
children.description: This container defines the graph of Internal Transitions within this Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMInternalTransitionDestRef
children.description: This is the reference to the destination Checkpoint of a Internal Transition within this Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMInternalTransitionSourceRef
children.description: This is the reference to the source Checkpoint of a Internal Transition within this Supervised Entity.

children.name: WdgMWatchdog
children.description: This container collects all common (mode-independent) parameters of a Watchdog to be triggered by the Watchdog Manager.

children.name: WdgMWatchdogName
children.description: This parameter shall contain the symbolic name of the watchdog instance.

children.name: WdgMWatchdogDeviceRef
children.description: Reference to one device container of Watchdog Interface. In the referenced container WdgIfDevice, the parameter WdgIfDeviceIndex contains the Index parameter that WdgM has to use for WdgIf_SetTriggerCondition calls for that watchdog instance.
